title: Kusoma kwa Mapana (Theme 4: Dira)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child keeps passwords and personal details private, opens nothing unknown and tells a safe adult.
representations: a list: what to keep private
steps: Ask: do I know this person?
contexts: a phone at a relative's house

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child sorts six cards into "nitashiriki" and "sitashiriki".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Rafiki anakuomba nenosiri la simu yako. Ufanye nini?" Kwa nini "Nimpe kwa muda mfupi tu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nenosiri na maelezo kama anwani ni siri yako. Usimpe mtu mwingine, hata rafiki.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Umetumiwa kiungo usichokijua. Ufanye nini?" Kwa nini "Nikifungue haraka" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kiungo au faili usiyoijua inaweza kuwa hatari. Mwonyeshe mtu mzima kabla ya kuifungua.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Unatafuta kifungu cha kusoma mtandaoni. Utumie tovuti ipi?" Kwa nini "Tovuti yoyote inayotokea kwanza" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Tumia tovuti salama zilizopendekezwa na mwalimu au mzazi. Tovuti inayoomba nambari ya simu au pesa si salama.
Usikutane na mtu uliyemjua mtandaoni; mwambie mzazi au mwalimu.

checks.question: Rafiki anaomba nenosiri lako. Ufanye nini?

skills.key_step: The child opens the folder before the file and searches with two or three key words on a safe site.

floor.prerequisite: Switches a computer or tablet on and off safely.
floor.question: Ni kitufe kipi huwasha tarakilishi?

representations: a real box file with papers (folder and file)
two screenshots: a real page and a trap
steps: Search with key words on a safe site.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child opens the folder and the file on a real device or in order on cards.

listen_for: bonyeza "Dira na mwelekeo" kwenye skrini ya mwanzo
misconceptions.ask: Faili hii iko ndani ya nini?
misconceptions.repair: Faili huhifadhiwa ndani ya folda; fungua folda kwanza, kisha faili.

listen_for: naomba unipe habari zote kuhusu dira tafadhali
misconceptions.ask: Ni maneno gani muhimu katika swali hili?
misconceptions.repair: Andika maneno mawili au matatu muhimu tu, na uyaandike kwa tahajia sahihi.

misconceptions.ask: Je, ulishiriki shindano lolote? Kwa nini ushinde simu?
misconceptions.repair: Ujumbe wa zawadi usiotarajiwa ni mtego; usiubonyeze.

misconceptions.ask: Kwa nini tovuti ya hadithi ihitaji nambari ya simu?
misconceptions.repair: Usimpe mtu yeyote mtandaoni jina lako kamili, shule yako wala nambari ya simu.

misconceptions.ask: Unaweza kutafuta kabla ya kufungua kivinjari?
misconceptions.repair: Washa kifaa, fungua kivinjari, andika maneno muhimu, chagua tovuti salama, soma.

checks.question: Andika maneno muhimu ya kutafuta habari kuhusu dira.
